annotations.title: Audit a URL for AI crawlers

description: Audit one URL: fetch it as 16 AI and search crawlers plus curl and a browser, check robots.txt, structured data, answer-first content, freshness, hreflang and llms.txt, plus classic on-page SEO (title, meta description, H1, canonical, noindex, image alt text, broken links). Returns a Markdown report with findings and fixes. language: report language code (en, de, ja, …).

bots.description: Only test these crawlers, by name (for example GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended). Omit to test all 16 AI and search crawlers.
bots.title: Bots

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 60 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

url.description: Page to audit: a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com (https is assumed).
url.title: Url

name: audit_url
